_doc: Training loops for Map 1 Kaltenbrunn (Update 03 section 3, T-056). Same format as routes_map00.json. Validate: gravelight/tools_src/route_tool.tscn -- --map=map01 --validate.

routes.label: round the headframe
routes.notes: The Minehead Yard (spawn): round the tower base (x 15-25, z 10-20), between the gatehouse and the coal shed on the north side.

routes.label: the Pew Loop
routes.notes: The Salt Chapel's outer aisles round the four pew blocks; the north aisle passes south of the font, the south one between the pews and the salt columns.

routes.label: round turbine 1
routes.notes: The Generator Hall: round the first turbine (x 45-54, z 67-73), through the T1-T2 gap; the T2-T3 gap is the Live Wire Fence's, so it stays off the loop.
